value.description:
The value representing the model output.

If a numerical value and {@link range} is populated, shows a risk gauge component where the gauge is set
relative to where the value lies within the given range.

Otherwise, the raw value will be displayed.

range.description:
A numerical range putting the {@link value} in context for criticality purposes, if applicable.
If populated, {@link value} must be a numerical value that lies within the given range.

title:
Represents the model output associated with a {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert} or other
types of alerts mixing in {@link ReliabilityAssetAlertBase}.
Typically is some value representative of alert criticality, e.g. risk score for anomaly detection or predicted time to failure.
When fetched in the UI, renders depending on which fields are populated using the `UiSdlAlertModelOutputGridCell` component.
name: ReliabilityAssetAlert.ModelOutput
